message:
Running command: # Try inputs where :: expansion happens with IPv4 and many hex groups
for addr in "1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9:a:b:c:d:e:f:10::1.2.3.4" "::1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9:a:b:c:d:e:f:10.1.2.3.4" "1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9:a:b:c:d:e:f:10::" "::1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9:a:b:c:d:e:f:10"; do
  printf "coap get $addr test\r\n" > /tmp/test_input.bin
  result=$(/tmp/cli-uart-fuzzer /tmp/test_input.bin 2>&1)
  echo "$addr: exit=$?"
done
